editorial.description: Translation is not simply about finding the right words. It is about understanding the message, preserving its intent, and making it feel natural in another language. Asmaa Adel helps businesses and individuals communicate clearly across Arabic and English with precision, context, and care.

values.title: Meaning Comes First
values.text: Words may change between languages. Meaning should not. Every translation is crafted to preserve the message, intent, and context behind the original.

values.title: Quality You Can Rely On
values.text: From the first draft to the final review, every detail matters. Accuracy, consistency, and clarity are treated as essential—not optional.

values.title: Built Around Your Message
values.text: Different content needs different treatment. Legal, medical, financial, and literary texts are translated with the terminology, tone, and context each one deserves.

items.title: Academic Foundation
items.desc: Earned a Bachelor of Arts and Education in English Language — Basic Education from Beni-Suef University.

items.title: Communication Experience
items.desc: Joined Vodafone as a Tele Sales Representative, developing strong communication, client-handling, and problem-solving skills.

items.title: Professional Translation
items.desc: Started working professionally in translation, handling Arabic–English and English–Arabic content across specialized fields.

items.title: Growing Through Language
items.desc: Continuing to build expertise in professional translation while helping clients communicate with greater clarity and confidence.
